name: 99501 · Anchorage, AK
findings: ZIP 99501 (Anchorage) has 228 nonprofit organizations. 105 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99501 (Anchorage) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 99501 (Anchorage) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 57 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
